record_id: Stable unique identifier for one ASME table source row.
vesselm_specification_ids: VesselM guide designation linked to the source row.
source_product_form: Product-form wording transcribed from the ASME table.
source_type_grade: Type or grade exactly represented in the source metadata row.
section_viii_division_1_applicability: Maximum-temperature and permission field from the Table 1A, 1B or 3 applicability page.
temperature_stress_points: All published temperature columns, including unavailable cells as null.
source_note_ids: ASME note identifiers that must be reviewed in the controlled source.
match_status: How the VesselM guide designation was associated with the ASME row.
approval_status: Engineering data governance state. Draft values are not approved for final design.
